SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: GlobalQualityWeight is smoothed by math.lerp hysteresis. Below 0.3 the supply solver probabilistically reuses cached economy state, item evaluation collapses toward 10 items and is also capped by Tuning.ItemEvaluationLimit, sector evaluation becomes distributed samples across the full 101x101 grid with the real BaseAup sector forced into sample 0, route solves approach 1, A* uses one shared frost-tick iteration budget instead of one budget per marauder, and the weighted heuristic rises smoothly toward 1.85x for low-priority thermal routes. A* threat reads use global sector indices resolved from SourceAup plus local integer offsets, so low-tier partial routes and high-tier exact routes query the same SectorEconomy truth. At quality 1.0 the heuristic weight returns to 1.0, restoring exact A* ordering while still respecting the tick budget. Visual proxy hydration budget approaches 2 matrices at low quality. When the sector budget reaches full capacity, sampling switches to direct 1:1 sector traversal so high/ultra passes evaluate every sector exactly once. Base demand uses subtract-first local float3, a smooth polynomial, and math.step gating. Route truth remains double3 AUP and persisted AUP rows are millimeter-quantized after integration.
